entities.name: Returned
entities.description: Undead creatures that have escaped the Underworld on Theros, separated from their memories, which manifest as eidolons.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where the Returned exist.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The domain of Erebos with five wards, to which dead mortals are ferried.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: The god who ferries dead mortals across the Tartyx River to the wards of the Underworld.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of the Underworld, who sent Tymaret to slaughter escaped Returned.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: The first mortal to escape the land of the dead via the Path of Phenax, now the god of deception who claims Iretis for his Returned.

entities.name: Tartyx River
entities.description: The river whose waters strip souls of their identity, creating Returned and eidolons.

entities.name: Path of Phenax
entities.description: The route out of the land of the dead first found by Phenax.

entities.name: Eidolon
entities.description: Nyxborn spirit that is the physical manifestation of the identity washed from a Returned.

entities.name: Asphodel
entities.description: A necropolis in the marsh of the Despair Lands, home to Returned who wish to be left alone.

entities.name: Order of Phaios
entities.description: Mages specializing in blood magic who defend Asphodel.

entities.name: Aphemia
entities.description: A harpy able to control the Returned with her song, prowling outside Asphodel.

entities.name: Odunos
entities.description: A necropolis occupied by resentful Returned who raid the living.

entities.name: Tymaret
entities.description: The monarch of Odunos, sent by Erebos to slaughter the escaped Returned.

entities.name: Iretis
entities.description: A former Meletian city ruled by King Kedarick VI, destroyed by leonin and claimed by Phenax as a necropolis.

entities.name: Kedarick VI
entities.description: The king of Iretis before its destruction.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A nightmare-weaving figure who with Phenax escalated fears between Iretis and the leonin.

events.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the land of the dead by using the Tartyx's waters to strip himself of identity.
events.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to find a route of escape out of the land of the dead

events.summary: Other denizens of the Underworld replicate his escape, some assisted by Phenax, creating the Returned.
events.quote: other denizens of the Underworld replicated his escape

events.summary: Erebos sends Tymaret to slaughter the escaped Returned, and Tymaret becomes monarch of Odunos.
events.quote: Tymaret, who was sent by Erebos to slaughter the escaped Returned

events.summary: Ashiok and Phenax plague Iretis and the leonin with nightmares until the leonin destroy the polis; Phenax claims it as a necropolis.
events.quote: Phenax then claimed Iretis as a new necropolis for his Returned.

relations.note: Ferries mortals to the domain of Erebos.
relations.quote: ferried by Athreos across the Tartyx River

relations.note: Sent by Erebos to slaughter escaped Returned.
relations.quote: who was sent by Erebos to slaughter the escaped Returned
